title: Passage to Chult
epigraph: Azlund put them under a zone of truth in the House of Healing before he would say the words Death Curse, then paid them fifty gold and a map of Chult to go find its source. On the crossing they traced a missing wheel of cheese to a Zhentarim stowaway, which was enough to make the passenger calling himself Corwin admit he was Artus Cimber and wore the Ring of Winter. He teleported them off the deck when the pirates boarded, and they came down in the Harbor Ward of Port Nyanzaru without him. Their first days ashore went to renting dinosaurs for a race and buying a canoe, while they collected the names of anyone who might know where the Soulmonger is.

title: Other People's Wars
epigraph: They went down the Soshenstar to deliver a medic to Camp Vengeance and arrived in time to watch the place turn on itself. After that most of their fighting was done on someone else's behalf, and the Flaming Fist took forty percent of what the party admitted to carrying home from the dwarves' forge at Hrakhamar. A naga at Orolunga told them the death curse runs back to Ras Nsi and a soulmonger in Omu. Since then they have been running errands for Artus Cimber after the Heart of the Wild, which they found as a dead tree, and the woman waiting in its temple who called herself the last warrior of Mezro has turned out to be travelling under a borrowed name.
